question: Is direction D009 already explored or contradicted: Stop presenting 'retrieval-agnostic' as a contribution. Treat the post-hoc gate as an implementation choice that makes one implementation reusable across retrievers, and report the cross-retriever result only as an empirical finding (per-retriever effect sizes and whether the sign is consistent), explicitly noting that measured retriever behaviour in regulatory QA is heterogeneous. The benchmark contribution and the valid-time-versus-recency comparison carry the work.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
